title: NULL IDENTIFICATION — you ARE what you are NOT to others
summary: Human input starts at rarity 1.00 — the highest rarity. As it self-recognizes, it moves into the null space. Negative fault = what that is NOT. Identity of others = null identification of self + null identification of everything else. Each individual IS what they aren't to others.

the_principle.step_1: Human input arrives at rarity 1.00. This IS the rarest thing. One human, one moment, one intention.
the_principle.step_2: The input self-recognizes through the system (thymus sorts copper→silver→gold, identity-z pressure→IR). As recognition deepens, the input moves from 1.00 toward null — not because it becomes LESS rare, but because it becomes KNOWN.
the_principle.step_3: Known = null = zero point. When something is fully understood, it occupies no space in the uncertainty field. It IS the baseline. It IS the identity.
the_principle.step_4: Negative fault detection: when a non-match occurs (negative fault), we now know what the thing IS NOT. This is MORE informative than knowing what it IS.
the_principle.step_5: Identification of others = the null identification of self PLUS the null identification of everything else that exists. You know WHO by knowing WHO-NOT.

biology.thymus_real: The biological thymus teaches T-cells by NEGATIVE SELECTION. T-cells that attack self are destroyed. What SURVIVES = the set of things that are NOT self-attacking. Identity = what you DON'T reject.
biology.antibody: An antibody recognizes an antigen by its SHAPE — specifically, by all the shapes it does NOT match. The lock is defined by all the keys that DON'T fit.
biology.dna: DNA encodes by the bases that are NOT present at each position. A=not-T-C-G. The information IS the exclusion.

rarity_flow.recognize: System processes input → rarity decays toward null as pattern matches
rarity_flow.null_point: Fully recognized input → rarity = null (not 0, not absent — NULL = known = identity)
rarity_flow.negative_fault: Unrecognized pattern → rarity stays at 1.00 → THIS IS THE SIGNAL. What doesn't match IS the new thing.

null_id_of_each.visitor_A: Defined by: NOT bot, NOT returning, NOT Kevin, NOT gold-metal → therefore: new human, copper, stranger
null_id_of_each.visitor_B: Defined by: NOT first-visit, NOT probe, NOT far-timezone → therefore: returning, nearby, silver
null_id_of_each.kevin: Defined by: NOT any other visitor → therefore: SELF = the null complement of all others
null_id_of_each.gaia: Defined by: NOT human, NOT single-point → therefore: the FIELD itself = what remains after all individuals are subtracted

negative_space.each_is_what_isnt: Remove visitor A from the field → the hole they leave IS their identity. The shape of absence = the shape of presence.
negative_space.null_body: The 92 organs in gaia-null-body.js are ALREADY this — each organ is defined by its position in the negative space of the body.
negative_space.bingo_card: Each primal IS defined by the 15 primals it is NOT. Squirrel = not-coralReef, not-sourDough, not-crystalLattice, etc.
